result.title: SegDis: Foreground Segmentation Followed by Type Discrimination for Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection
result.summary: Salient and camouflaged object detection (SOD and COD) both recover foreground support, yet most joint methods output only a binary mask and therefore cannot distinguish the type. USC12K distinguishes the two types, but its baseline USCNet still binds foreground existence to the type within a single normalization, so the failure source cannot be attributed. Our cross-task study shows that foreground localization transfers between SOD and COD, whereas type discrimination does not: a COD-only model recovers foreground on SOD images but its type judgement follows the training distribution rather than the foreground-background relation, so the two decisions require separate mechanisms. SegDis factorizes the output into an explicit foreground probability and a conditional type probability given foreground: FLR provides high-quality task-agnostic support, and RTA refines the SOD/COD assignment from the foreground-background relation without a task identifier. Because support is explicit, each ground-truth foreground pixel is classified as correct-type, type-swapped, or missed, so foreground-recovery and type-assignment errors are diagnosed separately. With PVT-v2-B2, SegDis attains 68.98% FG-mIoU and 78.35% mIoU on USC12K at about one-eighth of USCNet's parameters; CSCS is 5.75.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究显著/伪装目标检测中的联合定位与类型判别问题，发现前景定位可在两任务间迁移而类型判别不能，于是将输出分解为显式前景概率与以前景为条件的类型概率（FLR + RTA），并在 USC12K 上以更少参数取得更高指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式分解存在性与条件化类型判定 + 据此把错误分为类型正确/类型互换/漏检」的分项归因思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中「视觉证据是否留在内部状态」与「答案是否真正使用该证据」难以区分的问题，属于方法线索而非主线研究。
